newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end off 2.6 pct on Wall Street woes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end off 2.6 pct on Wall Street woes.

text.p: Brazilian shares ended off 2.6 percent in tandem with the Dow Industrials as sliding blue-chips weighed heavily on high turnover, brokers said.
The Bovespa index of the 49 most traded stocks closed off at 66,778 points. Market volume totalled a high 527.9 million reais ($509.2 million).
Wall Street stock prices dived amid bond market jitters that pushed up long-term interest rates.

Analysts also said the plunge in U.S. markets helped players holding short positions in the options market to pressure prices down. stock for the more-held options, dropped 3.53 percent to 76.60 reais.
The company's common stock fell 3.31 percent to 70.10 reais.
Preferred stocks of state oil firm Petrobras ended off 1.64 percent to 150 reais, while state mining firm Vale do Rio Doce fell 0.48 percent to 20.70 reais.
The Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index .IEE, comprising the nine most liquid stocks of the electrical sector, fell 2.67 percent to 1,830 points.
